title: JUKI DLM-5200N
subtitle: 1-Needle Lockstitch Machine with Vertical Edge Trimmer

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The JUKI DLM-5200N is a 1-needle lockstitch machine equipped with a vertical edge trimmer (sharp cloth-cutting knife). It cuts the fabric edge and sews the seam in a single pass, maintaining a constant seam allowance from the fabric edge — ideal for shirt side seams, panel seams, and similar operations where the edge must be trimmed cleanly before stitching.
applications: Single-pass edge-trim and lockstitch seam on shirt side panels and fronts
Operations requiring consistent seam allowance from the fabric edge
Sharp cloth-edge cutting and stitching on light to medium-weight woven fabrics
Production lines where trimming and stitching are combined into one operation
purposeAndApplication.industry: Shirt manufacturing, garment production (woven), light industrial textile assembly

overviewDescription: The JUKI DLM-5200N is a 1-needle lockstitch machine with a built-in vertical edge trimmer. The cloth-cutting knife trims the fabric edge just before the needle descends, ensuring a clean edge and a consistent seam allowance without a separate trimming pass. The machine uses bottom feed and runs at up to 4,500 sti/min with a maximum stitch length of 5 mm (forward and reverse feed). Presser foot lift is 4 mm by hand and 10 mm by knee.

classificationTable.value: 1-needle lockstitch machine with vertical edge trimmer

finalNotes:
• The defining feature is the integrated vertical edge cutter — it eliminates a separate trimming pass and guarantees a constant seam allowance.
• Compared with the standard DDL-8700 series, the DLM-5200N trades some max speed (4,500 vs 5,000 sti/min) for the edge-trim function.
